morphology.value: 3D tremella-like micro-flowers assembled by porous rugged nanosheets

nodes.name: Hydrothermal Fe-doping of Ni(OH)2
nodes.procedure: Fe-doped Ni(OH)2 precursors are first modified onto Ni foam via a hydrothermal method. The doping ratio of Fe-cation can be adjusted by controlling the iron nitrate nonahydrate during hydrothermal process.
nodes.source_text: Fe-doped Ni(OH)2 precursors are first modified onto Ni foam via a hydrothermal method... controlling the iron nitrate nonahydrate during hydrothermal process.

nodes.name: Phosphating and nitrogen doping calcination
nodes.procedure: The Fe-doped Ni(OH)2 precursors are subsequently calcined under Ar/H2 (95/5) atmosphere with sodium hypophosphite and ammonium bicarbonate as phosphorus and nitrogen source, respectively. The surface of tremella-like precursors is converted into rough and porous morphology after the pyrolysis process.

nodes.characterization_summary: For N/Fe-Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅, diffraction peaks match pure Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅ with high degree; Fe-doped shows slight shift to lower angles due to lattice expansion (Fe radius 1.27 Å > Ni 1.24 Å); N-doped shifts to higher angles (N 0.8 Å < P 1.3 Å).
nodes.evidence_snippet: after Fe doping, the diffraction peaks of Fe-N₂P/N₁₂P₅ shows a slight shift to lower angles (Fig. 2b), which can be ascribed to heteroatoms with larger radius (Fe, 1.27 Å, Ni, 1.24 Å) ... diffraction peaks of N-doped Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅ shift towards higher angles ... The main peaks of dual-doped Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅ exhibit a high degree of matching with pure Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅

nodes.characterization_summary: N/Fe-Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅ shows 3D micro-flowers assembled by porous rugged nanosheets; Fe-doped shows thinner ~2 μm microflowers; N-doped shows disordered porous nanosheets with open network structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the N/Fe dual-doped Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅ retain the 3D micro-flowers morphology assembled by the porous and rugged nanosheets ... Fe-doped Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅ displays a thinner nanosheets-assembled microflower with a size of ∼2 μm ... the nanosheets are transformed to be disordered and porous

nodes.characterization_summary: Tremella-like porous morphology observed with lattice fringes of 0.43 nm (101) facet of Ni₁₂P₅, 0.19 nm, 0.20 nm, 0.22 nm for (210), (201), (111) planes of Ni₂P. SAED confirms polycrystalline phase.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the high-resolution TEM images (Fig. 3f) shows clear lattice fringe with plane spacing of 0.43 nm, corresponding to the (101) facet of Ni₁₂P₅ ... The selected area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern ... confirms the formation of N/Fe-Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅ with polycrystalline phase

nodes.characterization_summary: N, Fe, Ni, P elements homogeneously distributed throughout N/Fe-Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the corresponding TEM-energy dispersive X-ray analysis (EDS) element mapping images ... reveal that the N, Fe, Ni and P elements are homogeneous distributed on N/Fe-Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni 2p shows Ni⁰ at 853.79 eV, 870.99 eV and Ni²⁺ at 857.13 eV, 874.85 eV with shift to higher energy vs pure Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅. Fe 2p shows Fe⁰ at 705.6 eV, Fe³⁺ at 711.88 eV, 725.42 eV. P 2p shows P 2p₃/₂ at 129.65 eV, P 2p₁/₂ at 130.67 eV. N 1s shows N-Ni at 398.45 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the high resolution spectrum of Ni 2p ... exhibits six similar peaks. Specifically, two peaks at binding energies (BEs) of ∼853.79 eV and ∼870.99 indicate the existence of Ni⁰ ... The peak at 398.45 eV can be ascribed to N-Ni bond

nodes.characterization_summary: C_dl = 11.9 mF for N/Fe-Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅, 8.53 mF for Fe-Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅, 6.45 mF for N-Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅, 5.95 mF for Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅ (C_s = 0.040 mF/cm²), giving ECSA = 297.5 cm² for N/Fe-Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the calculated C_dl of N/Fe-Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅ is 11.9 mF, which is larger than that of Fe-Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅ (8.53 mF) N-Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅ (6.45 mF) Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅ (5.95 mF) ... the obtained values are 297.5 cm² ... for N/Fe-Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅

nodes.characterization_summary: N/Fe-Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅ shows smallest R_ct of 5.65 Ω (vs 14.14 Ω Fe-doped, 31.2 Ω N-doped, 76.41 Ω pure).
nodes.evidence_snippet: N/Fe-dual doped Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅ exhibits smallest charge transfer resistance (R_ct) of 5.65 Ω, compared with Fe-Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅ (14.14 Ω), N-doped Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅ (31.2 Ω) and pure Ni₂P/Ni₁₂P₅ (76.41 Ω)
